eyebrow: SQL for Oracle Financials · Chapter Five
titlePlain: Reconciling AP and AR to the General
subtitle: Lesson 25 · Investigating Financial Data

code:
WITH ap_by_period AS (
  SELECT TO_CHAR(accounting_date,'YYYY-MM') period_name,
         dist_code_combination_id cc_id, SUM(amount) ap_total
  FROM ap_invoice_distributions_all GROUP BY 1, 2
), gl_by_period AS (
  SELECT period_name, code_combination_id cc_id,
         period_net_dr - period_net_cr AS gl_total
  FROM gl_balances WHERE actual_flag = 'A'
)
SELECT a.*, g.gl_total, a.ap_total - NVL(g.gl_total,0) AS difference
FROM ap_by_period a
LEFT OUTER JOIN gl_by_period g ON g.period_name=a.period_name AND g.cc_id=a.cc_id
WHERE a.ap_total - NVL(g.gl_total, 0) <> 0;
caption: ACTUAL_FLAG = 'A' restricts GL_BALANCES to actual balances, not budget/encumbrance.

code:
WITH ar_by_period AS (
    SELECT TO_CHAR(t.trx_date,'YYYY-MM') period_name,
           tl.code_combination_id, SUM(tl.extended_amount) ar_total
    FROM ra_customer_trx_lines_all tl
    INNER JOIN ra_customer_trx_all t ON t.customer_trx_id = tl.customer_trx_id
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT a.*, g.period_net_dr - g.period_net_cr AS gl_total
FROM ar_by_period a
LEFT OUTER JOIN gl_balances g
    ON g.period_name=a.period_name AND g.code_combination_id=a.code_combination_id
    AND g.actual_flag='A';
caption: Same shape as AP — subledger detail totaled by period and account, compared to GL_BALANCES.
